git_errors.conflicts.incomplete.one: Stopped on conflicts in at least {count} file (git's list may be incomplete). Resolve them, then continue or abort.
git_errors.conflicts.incomplete.other: Stopped on conflicts in at least {count} files (git's list may be incomplete). Resolve them, then continue or abort.
git_errors.conflicts.one: Stopped on conflicts in {count} file. Resolve it, then continue or abort.
git_errors.conflicts.other: Stopped on conflicts in {count} files. Resolve them, then continue or abort.
git_errors.conflicts.unlisted: Stopped on conflicts. Resolve them, then continue or abort.
git_errors.detached: No branch is checked out (detached HEAD). Create a branch first.
git_errors.diverged: Your branch and its upstream have both moved on, so a fast-forward isn't possible. Pull with a merge or rebase instead.
git_errors.fetch_moved_head: The fetch moved the checked-out branch itself and left your files as they were, so they now look like changes that undo the fetched commits. Save any changes of your own (compare with {commit}), then hard-reset to the branch to bring your files up to date.
git_errors.fetch_moved_head.unnamed: The fetch moved the checked-out branch itself and left your files as they were, so they now look like changes that undo the fetched commits. Save any changes of your own, then hard-reset to the branch to bring your files up to date.
git_errors.host_key: The server's SSH host key wasn't confirmed, so Git didn't connect.
git_errors.host_key_changed: The server's SSH host key has changed. Someone may be intercepting the connection: check with the server's owner before connecting again.
git_errors.local_changes.one: Your changes to {count} file would be overwritten.
git_errors.local_changes.other: Your changes to {count} files would be overwritten.
git_errors.local_changes.unlisted: Your uncommitted changes are in the way.
git_errors.locked: Another Git program is using this repository ({file} exists). Wait for it to finish, then try again. If none is running, delete that file.
git_errors.merge_in_progress: A merge is still in progress. Commit or abort it first.
git_errors.merge_refused: The merge couldn't start. Commit or stash your changes, then try again.
git_errors.no_upstream.pull: This branch has no upstream to pull from. Set one first.
git_errors.push_behind: The remote has commits your branch doesn't have. Pull first, or force push if you rewrote the branch on purpose.
git_errors.remote.certificate: Git couldn't verify the server's security certificate. If your network uses its own certificate authority, as many company proxies do, add that authority to your system's certificate store (on Windows, also set Git's http.sslBackend to schannel), or set http.sslCAInfo to a file that holds it.
git_errors.remote.certificate_host: Git couldn't verify the security certificate of {host}. If your network uses its own certificate authority, as many company proxies do, add that authority to your system's certificate store (on Windows, also set Git's http.sslBackend to schannel), or set http.sslCAInfo to a file that holds it.
git_errors.remote.no_access: Your account can't access the remote repository. Ask its owner for access, or sign in with another account.
git_errors.remote.not_found: The remote repository wasn't found. Check the remote's URL and that your account can see the repository.
git_errors.remote.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your network connection (and VPN or proxy), then try again.
git_errors.remote.unreachable_host: Couldn't reach {host}. Check your network connection (and VPN or proxy), then try again.
git_errors.remote.unreadable: Couldn't read from the remote repository. Check the remote's URL, your network and your access, then try again.
git_errors.sign_in.https: The server didn't accept the sign-in. Check the username and password or token, then try again.
git_errors.sign_in.ssh: The server didn't accept your SSH key.
git_errors.stale_lease: The remote branch changed since Glowfly last fetched it, so the force push was refused. Fetch and look at its new commits first.
git_errors.unknown_ref: Git can't find {name}. It may have been renamed or deleted.
git_errors.unresolved: Earlier conflicts aren't resolved yet. Resolve them or abort the operation first.
git_errors.untracked.one: {count} untracked file would be overwritten. Move or delete it, or stash it with untracked files included.
git_errors.untracked.other: {count} untracked files would be overwritten. Move or delete them, or stash them with untracked files included.
git_errors.upstream_gone: The upstream branch {branch} is no longer on the remote. Set another upstream, or push to create it again.
